description: Creates a ready-made word search puzzle for a theme and level, drawn from the 11 themed word pools (Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Fall, Winter, Bible, Animal, Math, Science, 4th of July and Kids), at an easy, medium or hard level. Gives the letter grid, the words to find with their positions, the directions used, the seed and a link that opens the same puzzle on WordsDesk to print or save as a PDF. The widget is playable.

level.description: Difficulty: easy (10×10 grid, 10 words, across and down), medium (13×13, 15 words, adds diagonals) or hard (16×16, 20 words, all 8 directions). Kids has one level, easy. Default medium.

seed.description: Letters, digits, - or _ that pick the puzzle. The same theme, level and seed always give the same puzzle as the website. Without a seed the puzzle is the first one the website shows for that theme and level.

theme.description: Theme of the word pool: christmas, halloween, thanksgiving, fall, winter, bible, animal, math, science, 4th-of-july or kids.

name: play_word_search
title: Play a word search
